, seek quashing of FIR No.222/2019 dated 05.05.2019 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Nangloi, Delhi.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners seeks, and is granted, three days for filing the Talaqnama along with the English translated copy thereof with an advance copy thereof to the learned APP for the State.

3. Learned APP for the State seeks, and is granted, further time of three days to verify the same.
